_comment: Support knowledge, not code. Tell Claude what to change in plain words; the engine reads this file.

facts.product: Each product has its own troubleshooting path.
facts.version: Supported versions differ, and menu paths changed between them.
facts.os: Windows and Linux fail for different reasons and are checked differently.
facts.log_source: An event log, a device syslog and M365 each break in their own way.
facts.collection_method: Agentless, syslog, API and file collection have separate procedures.
facts.recent_change: Collection that stopped after an upgrade or a config change is a different investigation from one that never started.

problem_types.label: Authentication error from the ingestion API

facts.product: Each product issues and checks its tokens differently.
facts.version: The token permission model changed between supported versions, so the rotation steps differ.
facts.recent_change: An error that started after a change points at the change; one that never worked points at setup.
